description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for the home screen of an AI tutoring app. It implements bottom navigation with three tabs: Sessions, Documents, and Code. It includes UI elements such as AppBar, FloatingActionButton, and BottomNavigationBar, and references other screens like TutoringSessionsScreen, DocumentsScreen, and CodeGeneratorScreen.

classes.name: HomeScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget serving as the main navigation shell with bottom navigation control for the AI tutoring app.

classes.name: _HomeScreenState
classes.description: The state class managing navigation state, UI rendering, and user interactions for HomeScreen.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for HomeScreen.

methods.name: _onTap
methods.description: Updates current tab index and refreshes UI.

methods.name: _onUploadPressed
methods.description: Shows a SnackBar to simulate an upload action.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the home screen, including AppBar, body, FAB, and bottom navigation.
